entry_state: Equity funding now has explicit price, fee, quantity, class-right and holder consequences. Percentage dilution differs from value transfer; conversion, repurchase, dividends and control require their own dated rules. The next chapter maps economic events into postings and reports, beginning with an accrual sale whose later collection is not new revenue.
exit_state: The event/report separation now covers inventory quantity, asset age, working-capital contracts, currency, entity-level liquidity, taxes and reporting boundaries. A same-day financial change can invalidate a prior remedy finding even if its date still matches, and an annual close must preserve unpaid claims and relevant memory. The next passage examines conversion and control.

observations.finding: Balanced postings are separated from valid economic events; physical quantity, asset age, contractual payment dates, native currency and legal entity constrain liquidity beyond balances. The parent example has 15 available against 20 due despite 35 consolidated cash.
observations.disposition: retain the conditional mechanics; institutional restrictions require actual sources in an application

observations.finding: The freshness rule compares date, projected economic contents and evidence revision. The prose explains why remedy-status metadata must be excluded from its own validity dependency and why whole-book comparison is conservative. It also states that a digest cannot establish complete evidence availability.
observations.disposition: retain; precise supplied dependency relation is reconstructible and its scope is explicit

observations.finding: Closing and carrying can preserve principal, arrears, shares and historical miss without falsely requiring every liability to be paid. The carried observation can remain historical while becoming stale for a new acceleration request. The distinction is a substantive cross-period consequence rather than an accounting-balancing check.
observations.disposition: retain; multi-clause and legal-terms extensions remain open as stated
